name: Zhevra Hooves
summary: Across the Barrens, zhevras graze the open savannah, swift prey with a powerful kick. Their hooves show that a hunter can face them.

sections.title: Trophies of the Hunt
sections.body:
Zhevras roam the Barrens on compact, muscular legs that can strike hard. Sergra Darkthorn, the orc shaman in charge of the Crossroads, sends new Horde scouts to gather the hooves of zhevra runners. The hunt tests a young hunter's instincts and resilience. A panicked runner can knock even a sturdy tauren flat.

Intact hooves show a hunter can handle swift, kicking prey before facing Kalimdor's deadliest predators.

faq.answer: Sergra Darkthorn, an orc shaman at the Crossroads in the Barrens, asks hunters to bring her four Zhevra Hooves as proof they are ready for tougher game.

faq.q: Where do Zhevra Hooves come from?
faq.answer: Zhevra Hooves come from zhevra runners grazing across the open savannah north and south of the Crossroads.

faq.q: Why are zhevra dangerous to hunt?
faq.answer: Zhevras can strike hard with their hind legs. A sprinting zhevra can knock an adult tauren off their feet, though zhevras are less aggressive than raptors or prowlers.

faq.q: Why does Sergra have hunters track zhevra rather than fiercer beasts?
faq.answer: Sergra sees zhevras as a step beyond plainstriders. They give newcomers firm but safe practice before they face truly lethal creatures.

angles.text: As a new Horde recruit arriving in the Barrens, you can show you are fit to defend the Crossroads by gathering hooves for Sergra Darkthorn.
As a hunter, you learn to track swift herd animals across the savannah and face their powerful kicks.
